Intercom Node.js SDK Compromise (Mini Shai-Hulud)

Target: intercom-client
Repository: https://github.com/intercom/intercom-node
Date: 2026-04-30
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft
User Impact: 0
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The Mini Shai-Hulud campaign compromised the official intercom-client package on npm. Attackers compromised a maintainer account and utilized a preinstall hook to run setup.mjs, ensuring execution before the package was even imported. The payload executed credential-stealing logic targeting GitHub tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, and .env files, sending them to zero.masscan.cloud.

Compromised Versions

  • 7.0.4
